scheme_name: NABI – National Agri-Food Biotechnology Institute Incubation
overview: The National Agri-Food Biotechnology Institute (NABI), formerly known as National Agri-Food and Biomanufacturing Institute, is an autonomous institute under the Department of Biotechnology, Government of India. Established in 2010, NABI focuses on research and innovation in agricultural biotechnology, food and nutritional biotechnology, human resource development, and technology transfer. The institute aims to catalyze transformation in the agri-food sector through value-added products, skilled human resource development, and translational science.
objectives: To catalyze transformation of the agri-food sector through innovative solutions
To develop synergy among knowledge providers and investors in the agri-food sector
To develop skilled human resource in agriculture, food and nutritional biotechnology
To provide leadership in agri-food biotechnology research and innovation
To improve nutritional quality and availability of affordable agri-food products
To be a nodal organization for knowledge generation and translational science
eligibility: Outstanding scientists working abroad who are interested in applying under the Prime Minister's Research Fellowship (PMRF) Scheme 2026 in the Young Research Fellows, Senior Fellows and Research Chairs categories, with an outstanding track record of high-impact publications, patents, technology development, or product innovation in areas aligned with BRIC-NABI's research mandate.
benefits: Opportunity to work on translational research, biofortification, designer crops, and functional foods aimed at enhancing nutritional security and promoting sustainable food systems; access to NABI's research infrastructure and facilities; collaboration with national and international organizations; potential for technology transfer and outreach programs.
financial_support: The evidence does not specify financial support details such as quantum, type, or mechanism of financial support for the incubation scheme.
application_process: 1. Interested candidates are requested to submit a research proposal (maximum 3 pages) along with their detailed curriculum vitae to edoffice@nabi.res.in on or before 2 July 2026. 2. For detailed information on the PMRF Scheme 2026, please visit: https://pmrc.education.gov.in/. 3. Applications are invited under the Prime Minister's Research Fellowship (PMRC) scheme 2026.
implementing_agency: Department of Biotechnology, Ministry of Science & Technology, Govt. of India
caveats: Applications are invited only for the Prime Minister's Research Fellowship (PMRF) Scheme 2026
Candidates must be outstanding scientists working abroad
Research proposal must not exceed 3 pages
Submission deadline is strict: on or before 2 July 2026
